summary: Adagene Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release regarding presentations at AACR 2026 of clinical data for muzastotug in combination therapies for HCC and MSS CRC. The filing reports interim Phase 1b/2 trial results, including response rates and safety data, with no mention of any corporate transaction, merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special situation. The registrant is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company reporting scientific data. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic corporate events are disclosed.
